Examples on this project
• CR-01 push notifications (Faculty of Business) → Deferred: scope creep, would consume float.
• CR-02 cleansing mini-sprint + contractor → Approved: recovers ~8 of 10 slip days, $23,800 from contingency.
• CR-03 mandatory MFA (Privacy Officer) → Approved: APP 11 compliance, uses float.
